cat > hera_scratch/ana_spots.py <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys, json
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import open_run, plot_raw, resolve_channels, current_channel, sdh_onset, sdh_fft
root=Path.cwd(); scratch=root/'hera_scratch'
for rid in (6,7):
    r=open_run(root/'data'/str(rid))
    fig=plot_raw(r,channels=['sr0','sr1']); fig.savefig(scratch/f'run{rid}_raw_review.png'); plt.show()
    chans=resolve_channels(r.meta); cur=current_channel(chans); v=next(c for c in chans if c.cid=='sr1')
    I=r.col(cur.col)/cur.gain; R=(r.col(v.col)/v.gain)/I; B=r.col('magnet_field')
    print(f'RUN {rid}: complete={r.complete}, interrupted={r.interrupted}, Rxx {R.min():.2f}..{R.max():.2f} ohm; drain {I.min()*1e9:.3f}..{I.max()*1e9:.3f} nA')
    for name in ['T_sample','k_2400_tg_curr','k_2400_bg_curr']:
        print(name, np.min(r.col(name)),np.max(r.col(name)))
    on=sdh_onset(R,B,r_full_scale=5000)
    print('Full-record diagnostic (censored/near-residual tracks are NOT established pockets):\n'+on.summary())
    if rid==6:
        on_low=sdh_onset(R,B,b_lo=.3,b_hi=4,r_full_scale=5000)
        print('Low-field-only diagnostic, excluding broad high-field MR:\n'+on_low.summary())
        print('Onset stability, b_hi=4, b_lo=.3/.5:')
        for low in [.3,.5]:
            for deg in [3,5,7]:
                oo=sdh_onset(R,B,b_lo=low,b_hi=4,r_full_scale=5000,bg_degree=deg)
                print(low,deg,oo.onset_b)
    fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,4))
    for low,high,deg in [(1,4,3),(1,6,5),(1.5,8,5),(2,10,3),(2,10,7)]:
        f,S=sdh_fft(R[:,None],B,b_range=(low,high),bg_degree=deg,nfft=4096,log=False)
        ax.plot(f,S[0]/np.max(S[0]),label=f'{low}-{high} T, degree {deg}')
        peaks,_=find_peaks(S[0],prominence=.05*np.max(S[0]))
        print('FFT',rid,(low,high,deg),np.round(f[peaks[(f[peaks]>3)&(f[peaks]<65)]],2))
    ax.set(xlim=(0,65),xlabel='Frequency (T)',ylabel='Normalized FFT amplitude',title=f'Run {rid}: extraction stability, signed Rxx, no log')
    ax.legend(fontsize=8); fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(scratch/f'run{rid}_fft_review.png'); plt.show()

## Runs 6–7 — spot-check review before the stacking fan

Raw traces precede the FFT diagnostics below. Both runs completed without clipping (sr1 5 kΩ full scale), with drain current 9.81–9.94 nA, sample temperature 1.165–1.292 K and |gate current| below 0.22 nA. The electron trace has reproducible spectral structure near 14.7, 22.2 and 29.5–30 T; the roughly 7 T component is sensitive to detrending and can be a residual. These are candidate spectral features, not a count of pockets: harmonics, mixing and the two CNP ridges remain unresolved. The hole trace has a stable high-window feature near 12.5 T but its low-frequency content and inferred onset also depend on window.

The default electron `sdh_onset` reports an edge-censored low-frequency track, and shortening the upper window to 4 T changes its onset to 0.91–1.38 T across defensible extraction choices. The 29.5 T feature has a more repeatable onset near 1.75–1.85 T. This is an extraction fork, not an established 0.3 T onset. Below 1 T run 6 used 50 mT steps, which cannot Nyquist the fastest expected frequency; its apparent low-field onset cannot set a classification-grade fan grid. A short, properly sampled low-field repeat at the shared electron density is needed to distinguish a true early-onset partner from sampling/background structure before committing the long fan. No stacking verdict is supported yet: B_1−B_2 is **uninformative for a definitive stacking assignment**, with measurable oscillation candidates.

Nominal model design values (fs_count_b0.py, densities converted to m⁻²): at n=+2.8×10¹², ABAB F=(6.04,22.91) T; at +3.2×10¹², (7.31,25.78) T. ABCA F_L=28.95–33.09 T. The absolute density scale remains a geometry prior; fitting one global scale to the entire peak set, harmonic screening, and the adjacent-N overlay are still required. The broad high-field magnetoresistance must not manufacture the low-frequency partner through a global polynomial fit.
MD

# sdh-spot-check: fine low-field extension, run-6 shared density.
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages
from hera.analysis import field_invB
import numpy as np

def _expect(label, actual, ok, expected):
    print(f'{label}: expected {expected}; actual {actual}')
    assert ok, label
for p, limits in [(k_tg.volt,(-.3,1.)),(k_bg.volt,(-1.3,2.)),
                  (dc205.smart_voltage,(-25.,25.)),(dc205.voltage,(-25.,25.)),
                  (magnet.field,(-10.,10.)),(heater.sample_setpoint,(0.,100.)),
                  (heater.vaporizer_setpoint,(0.,100.))]:
    actual=(float(p.vals._min_value),float(p.vals._max_value))
    _expect(p.full_name+' validators',actual,actual==limits,limits)
for name in ['T_sample','T_vaporizer']:
    assert_thermometry_live(name,VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[name],max_age=15,max_period=12)
_ts,_tv,_b,_si=T_sample(),T_vaporizer(),magnet.field(),k_si()
_expect('T sample',_ts,1<=_ts<=1.5,'1..1.5 K')
_expect('T vaporizer',_tv,_tv<1.6 and abs(_tv-_ts)<.6,'base, within .6 K of sample')
_expect('field',_b,abs(_b)<.02,'0 +/- .02 T')
_expect('Si',_si,abs(_si)<.01,'0 V')
for name,p in [('sample range',heater.sample_range),('vaporizer range',heater.vaporizer_range)]:
    value=p(); _expect(name,value,value==0,0)
for name,p in [('PS',magnet.persistent_switch_on),('output',magnet.output_enabled)]:
    value=p(); _expect(name,value,bool(value),True)
for lia in [sr0,sr1]:
    tau,slope=lia.time_constant(),lia.filter_slope()
    _expect(lia.name+' filter',(tau,slope),tau==.3 and slope==24,'.3 s / 24 dB')
_expect('magnet settle',magnet.settle_s,magnet.settle_s>=3.,'>=3 s')
_expect('drive',(sr1.amplitude(),sr1.frequency()),abs(sr1.amplitude()-1)<1e-6 and abs(sr1.frequency()-13.777)<.01,'1 V / 13.777 Hz')
for gate in [k_tg,k_bg]:
    _expect(gate.name+' pacing',gate.volt.step,gate.volt.step==.005,'.005 V')
    value=gate.nplci(); _expect(gate.name+' NPLC',value,value==1,1)
CAL=dict(c_tg=2.796e-3,c_bg=2.161e-3,n_offset=-.0894,D_offset=-.013)
_vt,_vb=calc_gate_voltages(3.2,0.,**CAL)
k_tg.volt.validate(float(_vt)); k_bg.volt.validate(float(_vb))
B_vec=field_invB(1.5,.4,222)
assert np.max(np.abs(np.diff(1/B_vec)))<1/(3*1.2*33.09)
sr1.sensitivity(5e-6)
mc=dict(meas_config); mc.update({'Si (V)':_si,'sample_temperature:':_ts,'comments':'fine onset repeat n=3.2e12 D=0; B 1.5 -> 0.4 T uniform inverse B 222; sr1 5uV; run-6 calibration'})
s=sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(mc['comments'])
s.ramp(k_bg.volt,float(_vb)); s.ramp(k_tg.volt,float(_vt))
interruptible_sleep(3)
s.fp(T_sample).fp(T_vaporizer).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr).fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
for p in [T_sample,T_vaporizer,k_tg.curr,k_bg.curr,sr0.X,sr0.P,sr1.X,sr1.P]: s.plot('time',p)
# [time,B,Ts,Tv,Itg,Ibg,I_X,I_P,V_X,V_P]
def onset_guard(station,data):
    reasons=[]
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(data)): reasons.append('nonfinite data')
    if max(abs(data[4]),abs(data[5]))>1e-9: reasons.append('gate current >1nA')
    if not 1<=data[2]<=1.5: reasons.append('off base T')
    if abs(data[8])>=.9*5e-6: reasons.append('sr1 near full scale')
    if abs(data[6]/-1e6)<8e-9: reasons.append('drain current lost')
    if reasons:
        print('STOP:',reasons); station.interrupt_requested=True
s.register_run_after(onset_guard,())
s.sweep(magnet.field,B_vec,delay=0)
print('ONSET REPEAT END: actual field',magnet.field(),'gates',k_tg.volt(),k_bg.volt())
PY
cat > hera_scratch/md_onset_repeat.md <<'MD'
## HERA — resolve the fan's low-field sampling requirement

`sdh-spot-check` grid-change/low-field extension, required by `landau-fan` step 1 and the governing tetralayer investigation. Runs 6–7 are live and unclipped, but the electron onset is background-sensitive (ana 14–15) and the 50 mT sampling below 1 T cannot resolve F_L. Repeat n=+3.2×10¹² cm⁻², D=0 with the same run-5 conversion; sample 1.5→0.4 T uniformly in 1/B. This is the one prerequisite to fixing and landing the fan, not another survey.

222 points give Δ(1/B)=0.00830 T⁻¹, 3.0 samples per 39.7 T tone (F_L plus 20% scale allowance); nominal partner ≈7.31 T has 13.4 periods. Upper-window overlap with run 6 checks reproducibility. Below 1.5 T the observed |Rxx| is <60 Ω; 5 µV sensitivity gives 500 Ω full scale at 10 nA, over 8× headroom with improved low-field resolution. Keep τ=.3 s / 24 dB; driver settle=3 s supplies 10τ per point. No temperature or Si move.

Ramp math: from actual zero to 1.5 T, then 1.5→0.4 T totals 2.6 T / .137 T/min = 19 min; 222×3.1 s ≈11.5 min, using run 6's measured 7.46 s per 10 mT point minus 4.38 s ramp. Allow setup/reads for a 35 min budget. Ends at 0.4 T, gates at the spot, to position the fan once its lower edge is established. First checkpoint after 10 points (current, rail, leakage); second at 1 T and at completion (onset and overlap). The monitor is armed before execution. A trip stops acquisition; on this magnet kernel interrupt does not stop a field ramp, so any magnet concern requires operator action and actual-state readback.
MD
